verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Gitea marketplace or app directory for installing third-party integrations. Gitea's ability to reuse existing GitHub Actions in workflows is an adjacent capability: actions are referenced in YAML and fetched from Git sites, not installed from a directory. Integrations such as Drone, Jenkins and Slack are built on the API and webhooks rather than offered as directory installs, so none of this earns credit for this story.
